chapter: Opening and the Buddy Petit band
title: Buddy Manaday and his homemade banjo
summary: Zardis describes banjoist Buddy Manaday, who built his own banjo with a guitar-style head.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I guess we've heard of it anyway. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Any more about Buddy Manda today? Can you tell us? He played banjo. Did he play guitar too? Well I don't know. I never

seen him play no guitar but he was a good banjo player. Buddy made this banjo there. That's the banjo he made himself. You know what I mean? Yeah it's got an unusual head on it. Yeah, head on it. That's right. It's like a guitar head. And that was a good one too. He made it and he was waiting. Every time he'd catch him he was doing something on that banjo. But he was really good at it.
